25 | Wound X | 10 targets | 1 rnd/5 fail | 100' | Fm

# Descriptions
@@ 1
The target suffers a special penalty of -30 to all actions.
@@ 2
The target is rendered unable to speak for the duration of the spell.
@@ 3
The target will believe that he is afflicted with a wound of a type chosen by
the caster (i.e., roll an ‘A” severity critical on a chosen critical strike
table). The target will perceive all the symptoms of the injury, but will not
in reality suffer the effects. If as a result of the injury, the target falls
“unconscious,” the target will pass out due to mental shock for one round per
level of the caster. If as a result of the injury, the target would “die,”
then the target will pass out from mental shock for one minute per level of
the caster.
@@ 4
The target loses his sense of hearing for the duration of this spell.
@@ 5
A chosen limb of the target is numb and useless for the duration of this
spell. If the limb is a leg, the target loses 40% of his movement. If the limb
is an arm, the target suffers -40 to melee and missile fire using that arm.
@@ 6
As Wound A, except the apparent wound can be up to a ‘B’ severity critical.
@@ 7
For the duration of this spell, the target will believe that he is suffering
from the effects of one non-life-threatening illness (chosen by the caster).
@@ 8
The target loses his sense of sight for the duration of this spell.
@@ 9
As Wound A, except the apparent wound can be up to a ‘C’ severity critical.
@@ 10
The target loses one sense (other than sight or hearing) chosen by the caster
at time of casting.
@@ 11
The target is completely paralyzed.
@@ 12
As Wound A, except the apparent wound can be up to a ‘D’ severity critical.
@@ 13
As Minor Hypochondria, except the target believes himself to be suffering from
a life threatening disease.
@@ 14
As Sensory Loss, except the target loses all senses (i.e., receives no sensory
input whatsoever) for the duration of this spell.
@@ 15
As Wound A, except the apparent wound can be up to an ‘E’ severity critical.
@@ 16
As any one of the non-Wound spells on this list below 15th level, except the
effect of the projection upon the target can be delayed up to 24 hours. At the
time of casting, the caster must decide upon the trigger for the spell. The
caster can choose one of the following as triggers for this spell: a) time
period, b) specified movement, c) specified sound, d) specified touch, e)
specified smell, or f) specified taste perceived by the target.
@@ 17
As any one of the non-Woundspells on this list below 15th level, except
affects 5 targets. The caster makes one Base Attack Roll which is applied to
all of the chosen targets.
@@ 18
As any one of the Wound spells on this list, except the effect of the Wound
spell upon the target can be delayed up to 24 hours. At the time of casting,
the caster must decide upon the trigger for the spell. The caster can choose
one of the following as a trigger for this spell: a) time period, b) specified
movement, c) specified sound, d) specified touch, e) specified smell, or f)
specified taste perceived by the target.
@@ 19
As any of the Wound spells, except affects 5 targets. The caster makes one BAR
which is applied to all of the chosen targets. Separate rolls are made to
determine the nature of the apparent wound on each target.
@@ 20
As Projection V, except affects 10 targets.
@@ 25
As Wound V, except affects 10 targets.
@@ 30
As Projection V, except affects one target per level of the caster.
@@ 50
As Wound V, except affects one target per level of the caster.
